critique: The field is now appropriately sparse on a clean black background, and the two frames retain a broadly similar dispersed composition rather than exploding radially. However, the individual elements still read as tiny crisp, saturated pink/orange bacteria rods, not soft subdued organic cells. Their displacement over two seconds is also still slightly more active than a nearly suspended floating-cell field.

suggestions.why: A small post-process blur will soften the hard sprite edges and reduce the neon bacterial crispness without destroying the sparse cell distribution.
Lowering emitter velocity will reduce the remaining noticeable two-second drift and make the cells feel gently suspended.
